paragraphs: An early shift starts with vehicle inventory and account checks. Throughout the day, clerks serve customers, process agreements, inspect vehicles, and record rentals. Midday brings renewals and schedule changes, while afternoons focus on returns and damage checks. Before leaving, clerks reconcile accounts, archive records, and complete handoffs.
